title: Icons, richer styles, and persistent wizard preview
source_brief: User requested icon/styling planning, supplied go-nf, requested persistent preview below header and FIGlet Standard/Phoenix artwork, authorized implementation, then supplied the exact dark/light PNGs.
assumptions: This is the implemented design contract at the presentation boundary, not a reconstruction of all destination/save substates.
Existing save protocol is inherited from inline-setup; PLAN.md and CONTRACTS.md specify changes.
The user-supplied PNG artwork supersedes the planned generated SVG assets.
